# target
add_library(BixEngine STATIC "")
set_target_properties(BixEngine PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "BixEngine")
set_target_properties(BixEngine PROPERTIES ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/windows/x64/debug")
add_dependencies(BixEngine BixHeaderTool)
target_include_directories(BixEngine PRIVATE
    Runtime/Include

)

    Build/windows/x64/debug/Intermediate/GeneratedHeaders
)
target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE

)
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
elseif(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")

    target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE -Wextra)
elseif(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE -Wall)
    target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE -Wextra)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE /EHsc)
elseif(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE -fexceptions)
    target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE -fcxx-exceptions)
elseif(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE -fexceptions)
endif()
set_target_properties(BixEngine PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
target_compile_features(BixEngine PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-Ox>)
else()
    target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE -O2)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE -Zi)
else()
    target_compile_options(BixEngine PRIVATE -g)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
    set_property(TARGET BixEngine PROPERTY
        MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreadedDebugDLL")
endif()
